title: RCF Shared Definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced via $ref from every other RCF schema. ID patterns, status enums, version string, timestamp format, and the docRef shape. This file is not a document schema; consumers register it alongside the 11 doc-type schemas at validator init. From 0.4.4 the reqId/usId/prdId/bsId/tadId/tsId patterns accept an optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-REQ-001) so blueprint mechanisms can contribute namespaced doc ids without colliding with project-authored ids. Existing numeric-only ids remain valid. The adrId/tacId/fbsId/cnId patterns already carry an optional kebab-slug SUFFIX (0.4.3) and are intentionally left untouched: id grammar is mixed across types for tonight (prefix for REQ/US/PRD/BS/TAD/TS; suffix for ADR/TAC/FBS/CN); unifying is a schemas follow-up.

prdId.description: PRD identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-PRD-001) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

reqId.description: Requirement identifier. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-REQ-001) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

usId.description: User Story identifier. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-US-101) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

acId.description: Acceptance Criterion identifier. Supports hierarchical form (AC-101-1) and flat form (AC-201). Authors pick per project.

tadId.description: Technical Architecture Document identifier. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-TAD-001) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

tacId.description: Technical Architecture Component identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional kebab-case slug suffix (for example, TAC-004-payment-gateway) is permitted; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

adrId.description: Architectural Decision Record identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional kebab-case slug suffix (for example, ADR-012-choose-postgres) is permitted; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

bsId.description: Build Sequence identifier. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-BS-001) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

fbsId.description: Functional Build Specification identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional kebab-case slug suffix (for example, FBS-004-user-login) is permitted; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

tsId.description: Test Suite identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional lowercase kebab-slug prefix (for example, spa-TS-001) is permitted for blueprint-contributed docs; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

tcId.description: Test Case identifier. TS suffix (three-digit minimum, unbounded above) joined to a lowercase alphanumeric slug.

cnId.description: Code Node identifier. Three-digit minimum, unbounded above. An optional kebab-case slug suffix (for example, CN-042-store-validator) is permitted; existing numeric-only ids remain valid.

version.description: Semantic version string for individual RCF documents.

authoringStatus.description: Authoring lifecycle status for PRD, REQ, US, TAD, TAC, BS.

adrStatus.description: Nygard / MADR convention status for ADRs. Draft state prepended in 0.2.0.

executionStatus.description: Execution-state status for FBS documents and FBS slots within a Build Sequence.

cnStatus.description: Lifecycle status for Code Node documents.

attestationMode.description: How a third-party service dependency is attested by tests. Shared between fbs.dependsOnServices[] and manifest.preFlightConfig.servicesInScope[]. live: tests hit the live provider with real credentials. sandboxed: tests hit a provider-run sandbox. mocked: local fixtures or stubs; not ship-authoritative on its own. declaredMockOnly: operator has explicitly declared the FBS ships mock-only for this service. notShipped: the service is used only in local development.

scopeTag.description: Scope tag classifying where a behaviour is observable. Shared between user-story.acceptanceCriteria[].scope and test-suite.testCases[].scope. library: observable in an isolated library or fixture. runtime: observable in the running product against local integration. deployed: observable on a booted artefact against real config and real network. unclassified: migration state for chains authored before the scope-tag vocabulary shipped; ruleset-enforcing consumers decide whether unclassified is currently accepted.

blueprintSlug.description: Blueprint slug in lowercase kebab (for example, spa, rest, msg-consumer). Same shape as the id-prefix slug that namespaces blueprint-contributed docs.

standardSlug.description: Standards-pack slug in lowercase kebab (for example, wsd-naming, security-baseline). Used by manifest.standards[] and referenced by fbs.contextRequirements.standardIds.

id.description: Document id (matches the doc-type-specific id pattern).

path.description: Relative path to the document file.

docRef.description: Reference to a root document by id and file path. Used by the manifest.
